sections.title: Data We Collect
sections.body: We collect the information you provide when creating an account (name, email, organization name) and data generated by your use of the platform (company descriptions, agent configurations, pipeline run logs, and usage metrics). We do not collect payment details directly — payments are processed by Stripe.

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
sections.body: Your data is used solely to operate the Braavolabs platform: to run your agents, store your pipeline history, and generate analytics. We do not sell, share, or use your data to train AI models. Each tenant's data is strictly isolated.

sections.title: Data Storage
sections.body: All data is stored in encrypted PostgreSQL databases. Audit logs and activity records are retained for 12 months by default. You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.body: We use Stripe for billing, SendGrid for transactional email, Google OAuth for authentication (optional), and HubSpot for CRM integration (opt-in). Each of these services has its own privacy policy.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, export, and delete your data at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@braavolabs.com. We will respond within 30 days.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We use industry-standard encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Access to production systems is restricted to authorized personnel. We conduct regular security reviews.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy? Email us at privacy@braavolabs.com.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
sections.body: By creating an account or using Braavolabs, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you are using the platform on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that organization to these terms.

sections.title: 2. Service Description
sections.body: Braavolabs provides an AI-powered platform for creating and operating autonomous business workflows. The platform uses Claude (Anthropic) to generate agents and pipelines based on your descriptions.

sections.title: 3. Acceptable Use
sections.body: You may not use the platform to generate spam, conduct illegal activities, violate third-party rights, or circumvent the platform's governance and risk controls. Automated outreach is subject to anti-spam limits built into the platform.

sections.title: 4. Free Plan
sections.body: The free plan includes 1 company, 10 runs per month, and access to TikTok and LinkedIn channels. Free plan features may change with 30 days' notice.

sections.title: 5. Paid Plans
sections.body: Paid subscriptions are billed monthly via Stripe. You may cancel at any time; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. No refunds are issued for partial months.

sections.title: 6. Data Ownership
sections.body: You own all data you input into the platform, including company descriptions, agent configurations, and outputs. You grant us a limited license to process this data solely to provide the service.

sections.title: 7. AI Outputs
sections.body: AI-generated content (agent outputs, drafts, outreach messages) must be reviewed before sending. You are responsible for all content sent through integrations connected to your account.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The platform is provided 'as is'. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform or AI-generated content.

sections.title: 9. Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time from the Settings page.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at legal@braavolabs.com.

sections.title: What Cookies Are
sections.body: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. We use cookies and similar local storage techniques to keep you signed in, remember your language preference, and improve your experience.

sections.title: Cookies We Use
sections.body: Strictly necessary: a JWT session token for authentication. Preference: NEXT_LOCALE to remember your language. We do not run ad-targeting cookies. Analytics is opt-in (Plausible, cookie-less by default).

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
sections.body: Stripe Checkout sets cookies during payment flows for fraud prevention. HubSpot tracking pixels run only if you opt in. Google or GitHub OAuth set their own cookies during sign-in — those are governed by their respective policies.

sections.title: How to Manage Cookies
sections.body: Most browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies through their settings. Disabling strictly necessary cookies will prevent you from signing in. Where required, our cookie banner lets you accept or reject non-essential cookies.

sections.title: Legal Basis
sections.body: We rely on legitimate interest for strictly necessary cookies (KVKK Art. 5/2-f and GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)) and on your consent for non-essential cookies (KVKK Art. 5/1 and GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)).

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about cookies? Email privacy@braavolabs.com.

about.title: About Braavolabs
about.subtitle: Building autonomous AI agents & automations — without the agency overhead.
about.section1Body: Most founders need an agency, an SDR, a content team, an ops manager — but can't afford five hires. Braavolabs replaces that team with AI agents that run pipelines you describe in plain English. Spend approval, audit logs, and risk stops are built in so you stay in control.
about.section2Body: A platform where you describe what you want in plain language — agents, pipelines, integrations — and our AI builder writes it from scratch, or connects the automations you already run. Every action is logged, every dollar of spend goes through approval, and the whole thing runs 24/7.
about.section3Body: Braavolabs is an independent project founded in 2026. We build in public — every commit, every decision, every roadmap update is visible. Reach out anytime: hello@braavolabs.com.
about.section4Body: Our roadmap is shaped by what users actually run into — not by a 12-month plan written in a vacuum. Want to influence what we build? Try the free tier, give us feedback at hello@braavolabs.com, or follow build-in-public updates on social.
